CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(MobilePhone), LEN(MobilePhone) < 8), "+85200000000", IF( LEFT(MobilePhone, 1) == "+", MobilePhone, IF( ( LEFT(MobilePhone, 3) == MID(TEXT(Country_Code__c),FIND("(", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) + 1,FIND(")", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) - FIND("(", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) - 1)), ("+" + MobilePhone), TRIM("+"+MID(TEXT(Country_Code__c),FIND("(", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) + 1,FIND(")", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) - FIND("(", TEXT(Country_Code__c)) - 1) + SUBSTITUTE(MobilePhone," ",""))) ) )
CustomField.label: Mobile Phone - Exclusion
